name: execute-master-plan
description: Step 3 of a plan-first multi-agent workflow: start the execution of an already-decomposed plan. Resolves the plan folder, commits the plan if it isn't committed yet, reads the Coordinator Prompt that execute-plan.md already contains, and adopts it — dispatching one teammate per phase, a round at a time. Replaces extracting that block by hand and pasting it.
